intro: A long lunch on the water. An intimate dinner at your villa. A private chef, a menu made for you, and time to enjoy every course.
heroAlt: A private dining spread set out on a yacht in Miami
storyAlt: A selection of dishes prepared for private dining

steps.title: Tell us about your table
steps.body: Share your dates, location, guest count, and the occasion. Let us know your favorite cuisines and any dietary needs.

steps.title: Shape the menu
steps.body: Your concierge coordinates the chef, menu, service style, and kitchen arrangements. Pricing and availability are confirmed with you.

steps.title: Be a guest at your own table
steps.body: Once the details are agreed, your chef takes care of preparation and service. You settle in and enjoy the company.

ctaBody: An evening for two or a celebration for your whole group. Tell us what you have in mind, and we’ll help arrange the right chef for it.
galleryBody: A few frames from the private dining experience — from plated courses to tables on the water. Drag, swipe, or use the arrows to explore.
